tasks.name: Rewire and traverse linked structures safely
Use stack and queue order semantics
Use priority queues for repeated best-item selection

concepts.name: Linked-node rewiring
concepts.description: Manipulate a linked sequence by changing references while preserving access to the remaining chain.

concepts.name: Sentinel / dummy node
concepts.description: Use a non-data node to give head/interior insertion or deletion the same pointer-update shape.

concepts.name: Linked-list reversal state
concepts.description: Reverse a singly linked chain while preserving the unprocessed suffix using previous, current, and next references.

concepts.name: Stack LIFO state
concepts.description: Use last-in-first-out state when the newest unresolved item must be handled before older ones, especially for nested structure.

concepts.name: Queue FIFO state
concepts.description: Use first-in-first-out state when processing order should match arrival order.

concepts.name: Monotonic stack
concepts.description: Maintain only unresolved candidates in monotonic order so each new item can resolve dominated prior candidates once.

concepts.name: Heap priority invariant
concepts.description: Maintain a partial order where the root is always the next minimum or maximum priority item while insertion and removal restore the heap invariant.

concepts.name: Bounded heap for top K
concepts.description: Keep only the best K items seen so far by storing the current cutoff at the heap root.

concepts.name: Heap-based K-way merge
concepts.description: Merge multiple sorted streams by keeping only each stream's current frontier item in a priority queue.
